builds.summary: Two Q packets each deal 130+.75 AD[statFormula=2]+9% target max HP. A full stationary double-hit rewards AD and armor penetration.
builds.goal: Two Q packets each deal 130+.75 AD[statFormula=2]+9% target max HP. A full stationary double-hit rewards AD and armor penetration.
builds.hypothesis:
Poppy smashes the ground, dealing [30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [7 / 7.5 / 8 / 8.5 / 9]% max Health physical damage and making the ground unstable. 

The unstable area Slows enemies by [0.2 / 0.23 / 0.26 / 0.29 / 0.32 + (8e-05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] and erupts after [1] second, dealing [30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [7 / 7.5 / 8 / 8.5 / 9]% max Health physical damage again.
Bloodthirster/Infinity Edge/Eclipse provide high AD; Grudge supplies armor penetration; Profane/Youmuu supply AD and lethality. Infinity Edge crit is not assumed to multiply this spell. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

Target stays on fissure for 1s; log first and eruption packet, no E/R. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs. Report observed damage only while the target survives; any theoretical full-window overkill is a separate raw-potential metric, not damage actually dealt.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Bloodthirster, Infinity Edge, Serylda's Grudge, Profane Hydra, Youmuu's Ghostblade, Eclipse. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

builds.name: Heroic Charge: wall-crash burst
builds.summary: Explore a large Heroic Charge tackle plus wall collision number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Explore a large Heroic Charge tackle plus wall collision number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 E has two separate 120 + 0.6 bonus AD physical packets when the tackle actually reaches terrain: 240 + 1.2 bonus AD combined. AD and penetration improve both; a no-wall tackle only gets one. Hubris is capped to earned 10-kill buff state, and Profane active is excluded.

ceiling.targetName: Heroic Charge tackle plus wall collision
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, maximum target rank, game time 30 minutes, no elixir, dragons or allied buffs. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 900 current HP, 100 armor and 50 MR before any explicitly tested debuff. Owner starts at full HP. No free permanent stacks. Enemy pinned against valid terrain; both E impacts occur within a one-second observation window. Hubris exactly 10 credited kills, buff active. No Q, passive attack or R damage. Record raw potential separately from effective damage; do not count packets after the target dies.

kitEvidence.formula: Poppy tackles an enemy, dealing [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and carrying them forward. If Poppy tackles them into terrain, the enemy is Stunned for [1.6 / 1.7 / 1.8 / 1.9 / 2] seconds and take an additional [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.
